input.brief: Original story: Neri, a copper beetle, must carry a lantern over a puddle before its glow fades. Oru, an ivory felt moth, first competes for the light, then helps. Mention Neri in the logline. Show a handoff, rescue and celebration, no existing characters or brands.
input.notes: Keep the same lantern, dusk light and left-to-right travel in every shot. Give each character a clear goal. Make the reversal and shared payoff visible.

treatment.title: One Light for Two
treatment.logline: Neri and Oru learn to share a fading lantern while crossing a rain-filled garden puddle.
treatment.theme: A shared light reaches farther than a guarded one.
treatment.style: Original miniature garden at blue dusk after rain, copper and ivory characters against indigo wet stone, amber lantern practical, tactile felt and metal, shallow focus, no text or logos.
treatment.keep: Neri always has a round copper shell and six short black legs; Oru always has ivory felt wings with plain ochre tips; the lantern is a small amber glass globe.

arc.purpose: Establish the fading lantern and the far bank.
Reveal the clash between guarding and sharing.
Make cooperation necessary when the lantern slips.
Earn a shared dry shelter and steady light.

characters.description: Original thumb-sized beetle with round hammered copper shell, six short black legs and two curved black antennae.
characters.intention: Bring the fading lantern to the dry far bank.

characters.description: Original palm-sized ivory felt moth with rounded wings, plain ochre wing tips and two soft curled antennae.
characters.promise: The light seeker who becomes a helper.
characters.intention: Stay close to the lantern and learn to protect it with Neri.

lines.en: One small light. One wide crossing.
Enough light for both of us.

music.prompt: Original instrumental miniature chamber score, felt piano and brushed cello, 72 BPM, no vocals.

cues.prompt: Sparse felt piano, 72 BPM, curious concern, no vocals.
Pizzicato cello and felt piano, 80 BPM, gentle friction, no vocals.
Bowed cello rising over piano pulses, 88 BPM, fear becoming trust, no vocals.
Soft piano and sustained cello, 64 BPM, warm relief, no vocals.

input.brief: Fiction originale : Lune, souris en feutre bleu, veut porter une graine à une jardinière. Piko, hérisson en bois, veut réparer leur petit pont. Mentionner Lune dans le logline anglais. Une perte puis un sauvetage rendent la plantation possible. Narration en français contenant graine; aucun personnage existant.
input.notes: Même pluie douce, direction gauche-droite et graine identique. Montrer une rencontre, une aide et une célébration. Aucun texte dans les images.

treatment.title: The Seed Bridge
treatment.logline: Lune and Piko repair a rain-soaked bridge to bring one seed to an empty planter.
treatment.theme: Growing something new starts by helping someone cross.
treatment.style: Original handmade garden in blue felt, pale carved wood and terracotta; gentle rain, overcast key and warm planter-side practical, macro textures, no lettering or logos.
treatment.keep: Lune is always a blue felt mouse with cream ears and a short braided tail; Piko is always a pale wooden hedgehog with blunt carved quills and a moss scarf.

arc.purpose: Show a seed and an unreachable planter.
Bring Lune and Piko together at the broken bridge.
Recover the dropped seed by trusting each other.
Earn the planting and hold their shared pride.

characters.description: Original small blue felt mouse with cream round ears, black bead eyes and a short blue braided tail.
characters.intention: Plant the single seed in the far planter.

characters.description: Original pale carved wooden hedgehog with blunt quills, round dark eyes and a plain moss scarf.
characters.intention: Repair the bridge so Lune can cross safely.

lines.fr: À deux, le chemin devient possible.

music.prompt: Original instrumental felt piano, wooden marimba and low strings, intimate garden scale, no vocals.

input.brief: An original silent tabletop story: a walnut wind-up crab and a small copper snail cooperate to free a wooden marble caught at a toy bridge. No speech, no narrator: lines must be an empty array. Mention marble in the logline. Use meet, help and celebrate interactions. No brands or existing designs.
input.notes: Keep the tabletop, warm window light, marble and bridge continuous. Keep all events gentle. Original instrumental music and physical sounds only.

treatment.title: A Way Through
treatment.logline: A walnut crab and a copper snail cooperate to free a wooden marble from a blocked toy bridge.
treatment.theme: Different ways of moving can solve one shared problem.
treatment.style: Original handmade tabletop miniatures, warm window key, cream background, walnut grain and hammered copper textures, restrained macro optics, no lettering or logos.
treatment.keep: The crab has a walnut body, six copper legs and rounded wooden claws; the snail has a small copper spiral shell and a cream felt foot; the marble is plain walnut.

arc.purpose: Trap the marble at the bridge.
Replace force with a shared lever.
Free the marble and celebrate together.

characters.description: Original walnut wind-up crab with six short copper legs, rounded wooden claws and a plain brass key.
characters.intention: Push the marble across the bridge.

characters.description: Original small snail with a hammered copper spiral shell, cream felt foot and two short felt feelers.
characters.intention: Find a safe way to unjam the bridge.
